title: A number with unanswered questions
subtitle: Understand uncertainty before drawing conclusions.
review_status: Authored educational prototype. Professional review has not occurred.

introduction.name: Jordan Lee
introduction.description: Jordan brings a fictional learning report with a score of 58 and an illustrative uncertainty range of 50–66. The scale has no real test, clinical cut-off, validated norms or diagnostic interpretation. Jordan thinks 58 means 58 percent correct. Explore that misunderstanding and the information needed before interpreting a score.
